bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to the Minnesota Paid Leave Law; transferring money from the family and medical benefit insurance account to the general fund.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+TRANSFER. +]

[+On June 30, 2026, the commissioner of management and budget must make a onetime transfer of $70,000,000 from the family and medical benefit insurance account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 268B.02, subdivision 4, to the general fund. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to the Minnesota Paid Leave Law; transferring money from the family and medical benefit insurance account to the general fund.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER.

On June 30, 2026, the commissioner of management and budget must make a onetime transfer of $70,000,000 from the family and medical benefit insurance account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 268B.02, subdivision 4, to the general fund.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: On June 30, 2026, the commissioner of management and budget must make a onetime transfer of $70,000,000 from the family and medical benefit insurance account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 268B.02, subdivision 4, to the general fund.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
